# ND-100

- **Name:** `nd100`
- **`word_size_bits`:** 48
- **`byte_count`:** 6
- **`byte_order`:** little-endian
- **`inherits_from`:** nd110-fields.yaml
- **Tokens in the file:** 300
- **Token file:** [`defs/tokens/nd100-tokens.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/tokens/nd100-tokens.yaml)
- **Field file:** [`defs/fields/nd100-fields.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/fields/nd100-fields.yaml)

Every mnemonic with its bits and description is listed on the [extension site](https://retrocorelabs.github.io/nd-microcode/docs/variants/nd100/).

## How the bits of a token are written

`encoding` has four strings of 6 octal digits: `w4` (bits 63-48), `w3` (47-32), `w2` (31-16) and `w1` (15-0). A token sets the bits that are 1 in its groups; the tokens of one instruction are ORed together.

## Fields of the word

This file lists only the fields that differ. The other fields are those of `nd110-fields.yaml`.

| Field | Bits | Width | Description | Used when | Default |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `TC` | 21:20 | 2 | Cycle-length selector. Two timing bits combined into a single 4-value field: 00 = FAST 01 = NORM 10 = SLOW 11 = WAIT |  | 2 |
| `VECT0` | 25 | 1 | Inverted VECT. When 0 (active), the lower 4 bits of the branch target are taken from one of IR / ALD / RA (selected by MIS) instead of from PROM bits 0:3. When 1 (inactive), PROM supplies all 12 bits of the branch target. |  | 1 |
| `SLWCS0` | 26 | 1 | Inverted slow-CS / WCS-load enable. When 0 (active), initiates START LOAD WRITABLE CS regardless of VECT0/MAPJ0 - the current microinstruction loads the writable control store instead of branching normally. |  | 1 |
| `MAPJ0` | 27 | 1 | Inverted map-jump enable. When 0 (active) with SLWCS0=1 and VECT0=1, dispatches to the macro-opcode decode-PLA address for the current macroinstruction (or to the interrupt vector entry if /INT RQ is asserted). |  | 1 |
| `IDBS` | 40:37 | 4 | Internal Data Bus Source - 4-bit selector. |  | 0 |
| `SEXT` | 41 | 1 | Sign-Extend modifier for the IDBS source. When set (together with IDBS = GPR, which is the primary documented use case), the GPR value is sign-extended from bit 7 to bits 8-15 as it is latched onto the IDB. This eases address-calculation and argument-instruction code paths. |  | 0 |
| `MIS` | 43:42 | 2 | Two-bit multi-role field. All three roles are confirmed on ND-100: (a) Shift mode when ALUM = 11 (shift instruction): 00 = ASH (arithmetic shift) 01 = ROT (rotational shift) 10 = ZIN (zero-end-input shift) 11 = LIR (link-end-input shift) (b) Page mode on memory-op COMMs (EXRQ/IRDRQ/DERQ/RDRQ/WRRQ): 00 = fetch / physical address (no paging) 01 = PT (normal page table) 10 = APT (alternative page table) 11 = HOLD (last-used page table) (c) Lower-4-bits source for vectored jumps (VECT0=0): 00 = IR(0..3) (used by TRA, TRR) 01 = IR(8..10) (used in memory-reference addr calc) 10 = ALD(0..3) 11 = A-operand bits All three roles share the same two bits; the active role is determined by the other fields (ALUM, COMM, VECT0) of the same microinstruction. |  | 0 |
| `EN_EXT` | 50 | 1 | Enable Extended register file. Same function as XRF on ND-110; renamed for ND-110. |  | 0 |
